desc.en: It is narrated from Jabir that after the passing away of the Messenger of Allah (s) two persons from among the companions of Prophet came to her and asked: How are you, O daughter of Prophet? She replied: First of all you testify my statement, did you hear the Messenger of Allah (s) say: “Fatima is a part of me; one who causes distress to her has caused distress to me.” Both replied: “Yes, by Allah, we heard this from him.” Fatima raised her hands to the heavens and said…
desc.rurdu: Jabir se riwaayat hai keh jab Rasool-e-Khuda (s) is duniya se chal-basey to woh dono ghaasib Bibi Fatema (s) ke paas aaye aur kaha aap kaisi ho ay Rasool ki dukhtar? Bibi ne farmaya: pehle aap dono meri baat ki gawahi do, keh kya tum logo’n ne Allah ke Rasool (s) se yeh nahi soona, “Fatema mere jigar ka tukda hai jis ne usko (Fatima ko) gazab-naak kiya goya us ne mujhe gazab-naak kiya.: Un dono ne kaha: “Ba-khuda ham ne un se yeh soona tha.” Us waqt Bibi ne apne haatho’n ko aasmaan ki taraf baland kar ke kaha…

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اُشْهِدُكَ اَنَّهُمَا قَدْ آذَیَانِیْ وَغَصَبَا حَقِّیْ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّهُمَا قَدْ آذَیَانِیْ، فَاَنَا اَشْكُوْ هُمَا اِلَیْكَ وَاِلٰی رَسُوْلِكَ، لَا وَاللهِ لَا اَرْضٰی عَنْكُمَا اَبَدًا حَتّٰی اَلْقٰی اَبِیْ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْهِ وَآلِهٖ، وَاُخْبِرَهٗ بِمَا صَنَعْتُمَا، فَیَكُوْنُ هُوَ الْحَاكِمُ فِیْكُمَا۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE USH-HEDOKA ANNAHOMAA QAD AAZAYAANEE WA GHASABAA HAQQEE. ALLAAHUMMA INNAHOMAA QAD AAZAYAANEE, FA-ANAA ASH-KOOHOMAA ELAYKA WA ELAA RASOOLEKA. LAA WAL LAAHE LAA ARZAA A’NKOMA ABADAN HATTAA ALQAA ABEE RASOOLAL LAAHE SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI WA UKHBERAHU BEMAA SANA’TOMAA, FAYAKOONA HOWAL HAAKEMO FEEKOMAA.

trans.en: O Allah, I call You to witness that the two of them have hurt me and have taken away my right. O Allah, Indeed the two of them have hurt me and I complain about them to You and to Your Messenger. No, by Allah, I will never be pleased with you two until I meet my father, blessings of Allah be on him and his family and inform him of what you have done and let him be the judge on you.
trans.rurdu: Ay Allah! Mai Tujhe gawah banaati hu keh in dono ne mujhe gazab-naak kiya hai aur mere haq se mujhe mehroom kar diya. Ay Allah! Kyu’n keh in dono ne mujhe gazab-naak kiya hai mai inki shikaayat karti hu Tujh se aur Tere Rasool (s) se. Ba-Khuda! Mai tum dono se raazi nahi hongi yahan tak-keh mai mere baaba (s.a.w.a) se ja milu aur unhe bataawu keh aap logo’n ne mere saath kya kiya hai aur un par mai faisla chhodti hu.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
